result.note: Bilateral air-services capacity increase with Vietnam; one question on the partner country and the scale of the change.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India more than doubled its weekly bilateral air-seat cap, raising it to over 16,000 seats a week, with which country?
questions.explain: India and Vietnam lifted their bilateral air-seat cap from 8,000 to over 16,000 seats a week. The increase came as airlines in both countries had used up, or were close to exhausting, their existing flying rights.
questions.source: India and Vietnam have lifted their bilateral air-seat cap to over 16,000 a week, more than double the existing 8,000.
